async ({ shell: { execFile } }) => {
  const push = await execFile("git", ["push", "-u", "origin", "feat/53-agents-md-context"], { timeoutMs: 280000 });
  const body = `Closes #53.

pi-action now puts the repository's \`AGENTS.md\` (or \`CLAUDE.md\`) into the system prompt, as pi's coding agent does, so the repository's conventions apply from the first request.

## What changes

- **\`src/context-files.ts\`**: finds, reads, and limits the context files, and defines the built-in \`pi-action-context\` extension with its one section, \`project_context\`. The text has the same shape as pi's \`# Project Context\` block.
  1. \`<agent_dir>/AGENTS.md\`, or else \`CLAUDE.md\`. Only when \`agent_dir\` is set.
  2. For each directory from the workspace root (\`GITHUB_WORKSPACE\`) down to \`cwd\`: \`AGENTS.md\`, or else \`CLAUDE.md\`. It never reads above the workspace. If \`cwd\` is not inside the workspace, \`cwd\` counts as the root.
  3. Nested files below \`cwd\` are not loaded. The section names up to 20 of them in one sentence, found with \`git ls-files\` so that ignored files are left out.
- **Read once per run.** \`run.ts\` reads the files during setup and passes the text to \`Thread.open\`. The section returns that fixed text, so an edit to \`AGENTS.md\` during the run causes no section update and keeps the prompt cache. A later run on the same thread sends the new content as a normal section update.
- **\`Thread.open\`** installs \`pi-action-context\` right after \`CodingTools\` and before the user's extensions, so pit's guidelines come after the repository's rules. With no files, the section is left out. \`createDurableExtensions\` reserves the name.
- **Inputs**: \`context_files\` (default \`true\`, as the issue suggests) and \`context_files_max_bytes\` (default \`65536\`). When the files go over the limit, the file at the limit is cut at a character boundary and gets a note for the model. Later files are left out and listed. Both write a log warning.
- **Pull requests from forks** (\`isForkPullRequest\`): the workspace files are read from \`pull_request.base.sha\` with \`git show\`, and the commit is fetched if a shallow clone doesn't have it. If that fails, no workspace files are loaded and a warning says why. The section tells the model the files came from the base commit.
- **Sanitising**: invisible characters are removed (the new \`removeInvisibleCharacters()\` in \`security.ts\`, which \`sanitizeInput()\` now also uses). HTML comments are kept.
- **Log**: the setup group gets a line such as \`Context files: AGENTS.md (2.1 KiB)\`.

## Docs

\`docs/prompts.md\` has a new section, *The system prompt*, which is the main reference. \`docs/how-it-works.md\` (the run steps and commit conventions; it no longer says "pi-action does not add them to the prompt"), \`docs/security.md\` (a new section, *Context files from the repository*: fork pull requests vs. branches in the same repository), \`docs/extensions.md\` (install order and reserved names), the README feature list and inputs table, and the CONTRIBUTING source table are also updated.

## Tests

- \`src/context-files.test.ts\`: the section text; discovery order (agent_dir first, then root down to cwd, \`AGENTS.md\` before \`CLAUDE.md\`); agent_dir equal to the root is loaded only once; the workspace boundary; the cut, with its notes and warnings; invisible characters; listing nested files (one per directory, ignored files skipped, cap of 20); fork pull requests (fetching the base commit from a shallow clone, and the base commit missing or invalid).
- \`src/thread.test.ts\`: \`project_context\` comes before the extensions' sections. It is left out without files. **No section update** when the agent rewrites \`AGENTS.md\` during a run.
- \`src/run.test.ts\`: from start to finish, with the log line in the setup group. \`context_files: false\` removes the section on the next run. A fork pull request with no base sha.
- Input, default, and reserved-name tests.

\`npm run check\` passes.

## Release notes

### Added

- pi-action puts \`AGENTS.md\` (or \`CLAUDE.md\`) into the system prompt, as pi does. This is **on by default**. Turn it off with \`context_files: false\`. On pull requests from forks, the files come from the base commit. (#53)

Not included: \`.pi/SYSTEM.md\` / \`APPEND_SYSTEM.md\`, and skills (#54), which can share the \`pi-action-context\` extension.`;
  const pr = await execFile("gh", ["pr", "create", "--base", "main", "--head", "feat/53-agents-md-context", "--title", "feat: load AGENTS.md into the system prompt", "--body", body], { timeoutMs: 60000 });
  return { push: push.stderr.slice(-500), pr: pr.stdout + pr.stderr };
}
